why: Settings opens Assistant settings (it replaced Model Providers on 2026-09-07). 2026-09-11 (Destin, review-2 R-4): zoomed 1.15 with the shared rhythm (0.3 s open, 1.5 s end hold).

actions.eval: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('[role=dialog]') || document.body; const s = [...root.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e => e.scrollHeight > e.clientHeight + 40 && /auto|scroll/.test(getComputedStyle(e).overflowY)).sort((a,b) => b.scrollHeight - a.scrollHeight)[0]; if (!s) return false; s.scrollTop = s.scrollHeight; return true; })()
